extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change of a function with respect to its input.

extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f(x)=x^n with real n, then f'(x)=nx^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Real Exponent
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An exponent n that can be any real number.

extracted_concepts.name: Constant Multiple Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx[cf(x)]=cf'(x) for constant c and differentiable f.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function built from powers and constants.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function of the form a^x for positive base a.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Exponential Function e^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Exponential function with base e, equal to its own derivative.

extracted_concepts.name: General Exponential Function a^x
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Exponential function with arbitrary positive base a.

extracted_concepts.name: Velocity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change of position; v(t)=s'(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Position
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Location as a function of time.

extracted_concepts.name: Acceleration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change of velocity; a(t)=v'(t)=s''(t).

extracted_concepts.name: Rate of Change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Interpretation of derivative as rate of change.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Use of derivative to estimate function values near a point.

Marginal cost is MC=C'(x).
The derivative is interpreted as a rate of change.
